page.layout: One column of running text, with a running head above it, the page number at top right, and a centred letter-spaced section heading in the middle of the page. No marginal notes. A catchword ("sive") stands at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: video nonnullos nimis anxiè sectari,) ut moleftam quandam superstitionem, & non levem studiorum remoram, vitandam semper judicavi. Mihi sat erit, omnia dicenda ad certas classes ita revocare, ut aliqua saltem cognationis vel analogiæ ratio appareat cur id factum sit: parum sollicito, nequis excipiat Ju-ramenti sensum & interpretationem ad Formalem, aut effectum aliquem ad Fi-nalem (Causam non satis concinnè reduci. Cum autem,ubi omnes causæ con-currunt ad effectum producendum, Ma-teria imprimis requiratur, ut primum Subjectum generationis; proxime Effi-ciens causa, quæ agendo formam producat; tertiò Forma, quæ in materiam per actionem efficientis introducatur; Finis denique, cujus gratia efficiens operatur: nos hunc quasi naturæ ordinem sequuti, à Materia ordiemur; hinc ad reliquas suo ordine progrediemur.
main_text.head: SECT. II.
main_text.p: Materiam Ju-ramenti intelligo rem illam circa quam versatur, & in cujus confirmationem adhibetur Juramen-tum: sive ea res spectetur ut Juranda,

page.notes: The first word of the page, "video", is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The section heading is letter-spaced; the "(" before "Causam" is a swash italic capital C, read as "Causam". Long s is transcribed as s throughout, e.g. "fit" read as "sit" and "fat" as "sat"; these two readings are the least certain. The catchword "sive" is printed at the lower right and is not included in the running text.
